facts.title: high potential incident - thermal exposure at SG-8000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on SG-8000 and TX-8001 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. SG-8000 (station switchgear) is in service for station HV distribution. The task proceeded during shift handover while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 12 June 2026 a high potential incident was recorded on SG-8000 and TX-8001 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during shift handover; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
